textRuns.value: Official figures: UDISE+ 2024-25 report (Table 2.2) and Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha answers for government schools. Enrolment includes pre-primary, as published. The same comparison, with a second independent calculation from the CSVs, is in powerbi/reconciliation.xlsx. Source: UDISE+, Ministry of Education, Government of India.
